chunks.title: Who is Gulong.ph?
chunks.text:
Q: Who is Gulong.ph?
A: Gulong.ph is the primary online provider of a diverse range of tire brands in the Philippines. We are affiliated with the Lica Automotive Group, one of the country’s largest non-manufacturing automotive groups. Our Corporate Office is located at 1166 Pasong Tamo Cor. Estrella St., Barangay San Antonio, Makati City.
At Gulong.ph, we prioritize convenience and quality service for our customers. Our offerings include FREE installations in selected areas, and nationwide shipping through our official website, Lazada, and Shopee.

chunks.title: Why should I order from Gulong.ph?
chunks.text:
Q: Why should I order from Gulong.ph?
A: 1. Best Prices in the Market – we offer tires at the best price with FREE mounting, balancing, wheel weights, and tire valves at our installation partner. Sulit!
2. Any Brand, Anywhere – we offer a large range of tires. You can choose a brand to have them installed at an installation partner near you. We also offer nationwide delivery and home installation
3. Complete Order in 1 Minute/5 minutes – order from anywhere and anytime with minimal disruption to your day.
4. Reputable Installation Partners - Our reputable installation partners ensure top-notch service for your tires.
5. Free Expert Advice - Our team of experts is here to help, offering free advice to ensure you make the best choice for your vehicle.

Q: Are your tires brand new?
A: All our tires are brand new and sourced from legitimate distributors in the Philippines. As authorized retailers, we guarantee the authenticity of every brand we offer.

chunks.title: How to order?
chunks.text:
Q: How to order?
A: 1. Go to our website at gulong.ph
2. Search by tire size or vehicle make and model.
3. Select your preferred tire and add it to the cart.
4. Proceed to checkout and select FREE installation at partner site, Home Installation Service, Pick up at partner site, or delivery to your doorstep. Select your appointment.
5. Fill out the form with your contact details.
6. Pay using your preferred payment option. Make sure to apply your voucher code!
7. And you're done!

chunks.title: Do you do same day delivery?
chunks.text:
Q: Do you do same day delivery?

Our standard lead time is 1-3 business days within Metro Manila and 7-10 business days outside Metro Manila. Kindly note that these lead times are subject to adjustment, depending on your location.
If you need your order delivered sooner, please message us, and we will do our best to accommodate your request.
Metro Manila only, with cut-off time at 11 am.

chunks.title: What's the earliest installation date I can book?
chunks.text:
Q: What's the earliest installation date I can book?
A: We have a lead time of 3-4 days from the order date, but you can request an earlier schedule or message us if you need it sooner. We will check if we can accommodate your request and confirm accordingly.
If the booking was made from 12 AM to 11 AM, allowed same-day appointment schedule is from 1pm to 3pm
If the booking was made from 11:01 AM to 1 PM, earliest allowed appointment schedule is tomorrow morning and afternoon.
If the booking was made from 1:01 PM onwards, earliest appointment schedule is tomorrow afternoon only.
Same-day installation is unavailable for Sundays and holidays.

chunks.title: What if I came in late?
chunks.text:
Q: What if I came in late?
A: Please advise us if you will be late, we will do our best to service you at the next available time. If not, we can always arrange for a reschedule.

chunks.title: What if I missed my appointment schedule?
chunks.text:
Q: What if I missed my appointment schedule?
A: We understand that there are circumstances which cannot be avoided causing you to miss your booking. Please notify us that you will miss your schedule and we will coordinate on this with the parties involved but do understand that we already incur cost to process your order and appointment. We may require a full payment for the security of our tires.

chunks.title: Can I reschedule my appointment schedule?
chunks.text:
Q: Can I reschedule my appointment schedule?
A: Yes, you can reschedule your appointment, as needed. But if you reschedule your installation appointment 2 days or more from the originally scheduled date, you are required to pay the 35% of the remaining balance on your order.
The payment is non-refundable and must be settled before the appointment date. We reserve the right to cancel your entire order if the remittance of required payment is not paid.
You may request for a reschedule of your appointment by messaging us thru our official email hello@gulong.ph, customer support team (+63 9278691128) (+63 9456875710) or official fb page:https://www.facebook.com/gulongphilippines.

chunks.title: Can I cancel my order?
chunks.text:
Q: Can I cancel my order?
A: Yes you can cancel your order. But you can only cancel your order 48 hours before your appointment schedule. Once your order has been shipped out and you still wish to cancel your order, your reservation fee will be forfeited.

chunks.text:
Q: Can I return/exchange my tires?

To request for a refund or return of tires, please email us at hello@gulong.ph or call the following phone number:+639278691128

chunks.title: What kind of damages are not covered by warranty?
chunks.text:
Q: What kind of damages are not covered by warranty?
A: SIDEWALL BUBBLE
A sidewall bubble typically results from road impacts such as hitting a curb or pothole. It's important to note that manufacturers generally consider this damage as a result of road hazards, stemming from the rupture of internal tire belts due to impacts, rather than a flaw in tire construction. Therefore, it falls outside the scope of the standard manufacturer warranty.
SIDEWALL HORIZONTAL CUT
A sidewall horizontal cut occurs when your tire is struck by an object on the road. Because it is not a fault in the tire's construction, it typically falls outside the scope of the standard manufacturer warranty.

chunks.title: What if I mistakingly ordered the wrong tire?
chunks.text:
Q: What if I mistakingly ordered the wrong tire?
A: Here's what happens when you order the wrong tire:
Send us a message thru our email, phone number or messenger stating that the tire you ordered is wrong and indicate the correct tires.
If your order has not yet been shipped out, we will check the availability of the correct tire size and provide you with the new costing.
If your order has not yet been shipped out and the correct tires are not available, you can cancel your order or choose to wait for the availability of the new tires. For cancellation of tires, see "Can I cancel my order?" for reference.
If your order has been shipped out for delivery or to your designated installation partner, you can choose to switch to the correct size or cancel your initial order but we have the righ

chunks.title: What is Gulong Guarantee?
chunks.text:
Q: What is Gulong Guarantee?
A: The Gulong.ph Guarantee is an unconditional warranty on all types of tire damage, regardless of the cause. This warranty is applicable on selected brands purchased from the Gulong.ph website and official Facebook page, provided they are used under normal driving conditions. The warranty is valid only for tires installed by an authorized Installation Partner (IP) of Gulong.ph.
Basta within 1 year, kahit anong mangyari sa gulong mo—mapako, mabutas, o masira—we’ll replace it!
Walang tanong-tanong. Walang stress.
That’s our GulongPH commitment to your peace of mind. 💯🚗
For more information, kindly check: https://gulong.ph/guarantee
